content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Assistant post under the Extramural Research Project titled "Satellite Centre for Tribal Health and Research (STHR)".

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualification: Experience in Public Health projects and knowledge of computer applications.

rows.qualification_required: Graduate in Medical Sciences. OR Graduate in Science/relevant subjects from a recognized university with three years' work experience from a recognized Institution. OR Master's degree in Public Health.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Salary
content_sections.text: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a walk-in interview. Candidates must appear in person for a walk-in interview along with the filled application in the prescribed format, bio-data, all relevant original documents, and one set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.aiimsjodhpur.edu.in to download the notification and application format. Fill out the application form in the prescribed format provided in the official notification. Prepare your detailed bio-data. Gather all relevant original educational, experience, and age-proof documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies. Report in person for the walk-in interview on 15 October 2026 between 10:00 AM and 11:30 AM at Room No. 238, 2nd Floor, Medical College, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Basni, Phase-II, Jodhpur - 342005.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Reporting time for candidates starts at 10:00 AM on 15 October 2026 and closing time to report for interview is 11:30 AM on 15 October 2026, after which no additional candidates will be entertained. The posts are filled up on a purely temporary basis, co-terminus with the project, and candidates have no right to claim permanent employment under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Govt. of India/AIIMS. All educational, professional, and technical qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University. Experience requirements must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post. Persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertakings must produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) is conducting this recruitment for the STHR project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Research Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Research Assistant post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Reporting time starts at 10:00 AM and the closing time to report is 11:30 AM on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must be a Graduate in Medical Sciences, or a Graduate in Science/relevant subjects with 3 years work experience from a recognized institution, or hold a Master's degree in Public Health.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is a consolidated sum of Rs. 31,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Room No. 238, 2nd Floor, Medical College, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Basni, Phase-II, Jodhpur - 342005.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is made on a purely temporary basis and is co-terminus with the project.
